segments.name: Wealth Management
segments.description: Provides full-service brokerage, advisory, asset management, wealth planning and margin lending to high-net-worth individuals, families and businesses.
segments.evidence: Through its Wealth Management business, Oppenheimer provides a comprehensive array of financial services through a network of 924 financial advisors in 88 offices located throughout the United States.

segments.name: Capital Markets
segments.description: Provides investment banking, sales and trading, research and market-making services to emerging growth and middle market companies and financial sponsors.
segments.evidence: Oppenheimer's investment banking business provides strategic advisory services and capital markets services to emerging growth and middle market companies as well as financial sponsors.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay commissions on transaction-based brokerage accounts, asset-based advisory fees on fee-based accounts, interest on margin lending, and investment banking and trading revenues from capital markets clients.
revenueModel.evidence: Clients may choose a variety of ways to establish a relationship and conduct business including brokerage accounts with transaction-based pricing and/or investment advisory accounts with asset-based fee pricing.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company wound down and deregistered its discount broker-dealer subsidiary Freedom Investments.
changes.evidence: In September 2025, the Company announced its plans for Freedom to cease operations and formally deregister as a broker-dealer.
